name: CADBridge
tagline: Connects Claude live to AutoCAD for exporting site layouts as lossless JSON.
description: Automatically loads a .NET add-in in AutoCAD that listens on port 48810 and exports the current selection of objects into a lossless, scale-preserving JSON file. The same export can be done offline using ZWCAD's `SITEJSON` command without an active listener.

page.objective: Connects Claude live to AutoCAD for exporting site layouts as lossless JSON.
